fusions.name: Pounce Lock
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Falling Gate
fusions.desc: Brings a barred gate down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Landing Brace
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Hopping Ward
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a stretch of ground, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 24 seconds.
